change.name: Q1_A3_quality_prior
change.formula: w = softmax_t(a_t + log(epsilon + q'_t)), q_t = mean_v clip(x[:,2,t,v],0,1) from raw input, q' = avg_pool1d(k=3,s=2,p=1,count_include_pad=False)

kept: nested LOSO 4 outer x 3 inner, epoch by inner CE, refit outer-train
primary policy fixed 0.5; balanced/sensitivity thresholds chosen on inner only
primary_metric: pooled accuracy, policy fixed, mean +/- sd over 3 seeds; paired delta Q1-Q0 per seed
decision_rule: Report the paired delta and seed counts as is; no p-value over 3 seeds on the same 160 clips. A negative or null result is valid. Nothing is re-tuned after outer-test results.
limitations: outer folds were seen during development of 06/07/08
4 subjects, seeds repeat the same clips
q is a MediaPipe visibility proxy, not calibrated confidence

config.protocol: 4 outer subjects; 3 inner subjects; refit outer train; no final all-subject retrain; only pooling differs between Q0 and Q1
config.quality_definition: mean_v clip(visibility_v2,0,1); centred avg-pool to attention steps

code_hash_note: runner.code_hash(): sha256 over name + NUL + file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF

addenda.summary: Fixes the DUC-04 analysis plan before any real Q0/Q1 outer result exists. Training code, config, inputs, variants and budget are unchanged; code_hash still applies.
analysis: Primary: pooled accuracy, policy fixed, per-seed paired delta Q1-Q0, mean +/- sd and seeds improved/worse (as in decision_rule).
All metrics incl. FN/FP and confusion matrices per variant x seed x policy.
Clip flips under policy fixed: fixed_by_q1 / broken_by_q1 counts per clip across seeds.
Mechanism: per clip corr(attention, q') and attention mass on steps with q' < 0.5, Q0 vs Q1. Accuracy gain without a shift in attention is reported as not explained by the hypothesis.
Known DUC-01 failure clips S4_FALL_05, S4_ADL_05, S4_ADL_06 reported for both variants.
